sections.title: One more word like vele and hozzá
sections.content: *bele* ("into it") is built the same way as vele and *hozzá* — a case suffix, this time -ba/-be from A1, lexicalized onto a 3rd-person pronoun. It's exactly what a recipe needs for "put X into it" without naming the pot every time.

items.spanish: Tegyél bele egy kis borsot is.
items.english: Put a little pepper into it too.
Put the garlic into it too!

sections.content: vele, *hozzá*, bele — three little words, three case suffixes you already know (-val/-vel, -hoz/-hez/-höz, -ba/-be), each one glued onto "it" instead of a noun. Once you spot the pattern, none of them needs to be memorized separately.
